metadata.title: The optimal isoperimetric inequality for varifolds
metadata.abstract: We prove the Brendle isoperimetric inequality for varifolds of finite mass and finite total first variation, allowing an arbitrary singular part. The distributional mean curvature is assumed only integrable. The result applies to integral varifolds and, more generally, to rectifiable varifolds with a positive lower density bound and weight measure concentrated on countably many $C^2$ submanifolds. The proof uses optimal transport and a locality theorem for the tangential Laplacian of an ambient convex function. The isoperimetric constant is sharp in codimensions one and two.

analysis.workSummary: 对有限质量与有限总一阶变分的 varifold，允许任意奇异部分且仅要求分布平均曲率可积，证明 Brendle 等周不等式。
techniques: 凸函数切向 Laplace 局部性
analysis.breakthrough: 余维一、二常数锐，并包含整 varifold 与某些带密度下界的可求长对象。
analysis.limitations: 更一般可求长对象还需重量集中在可数 C² 子流形；论文标注为初稿。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
